people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
translations.bsb: Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.
translations.kjv: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
translations.asv: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way toward Shechem; yea, they have committed lewdness.
